name: Wings Credit Union (formerly Ent Credit Union)
notes: Researched from public ent.com pages (no sign-in). Ent Credit Union (Colorado) changed its legal name to Wings Credit Union after merging with Wings Financial; it still does business as Ent at ent.com while rebranding (footer: "Wings Credit Union doing business as Ent Credit Union"). Consumer loans (not mortgages) are paid in digital banking: one-time or recurring automatic transfers from a Wings account, one-time payments from another institution (not lines of credit), debit-card payments for auto loans only, and ACH set-up in digital banking or at a service center; also service centers, shared branches and mail (P.O. Box 16769, Colorado Springs, CO 80935). Transfers can be scheduled up to a year ahead. No pay-without-signing-in page is linked (guest_pay unsupported, evidence inferred). Debit card payments are auto-loan-only, so the billed product is labelled "Auto Loan" and card is an online method; card-type restriction (debit only) is not expressible. Hardship: call Member Solutions (719) 574-1100 or send a Modification Request PDF form (payment_arrangement unsupported). Skip-A-Pay: $25 per skipped payment, loan open 1 year, eligible auto/RV/motorcycle/personal loans, offered in online/mobile banking special offers. The digital banking upgrade added multi-factor authentication (method not stated: family default); members keep their existing Wings username (auth.identifier username, set in review). eStatement page is an empty redirect stub publicly (paperless left to the family default).

pay_online.note: Pay your consumer loan in digital banking from a Wings account or an account at another institution. Debit card payments are available for auto loans.

guest_pay.note: Wings loan payments are made after logging in to digital banking. You can also pay at a Wings service center or shared branch, by mail, or get help at 719-574-1100.

autopay.note: Set up a recurring automatic transfer from a Wings account to your loan in digital banking, or an ACH payment in digital banking or at a service center.

payment_arrangement.note: Having trouble making payments? Contact Member Solutions at (719) 574-1100 or fill out a Modification Request form.

help.title: Ways to make a Wings loan payment
paragraphs: You can pay a Wings consumer loan (mortgages are paid separately) in digital banking with a one-time or recurring automatic transfer from a Wings account, or with a one-time payment from your account at another financial institution (not available for lines of credit). Auto loans can also be paid with a debit card in digital banking.
Transfers can be scheduled, one time or recurring, up to a year in advance. Same-day transfers work only between Wings accounts.

You can also pay in person at a Wings service center or a shared branch, set up an ACH payment in digital banking or at a service center, or mail your payment to Wings Credit Union, P.O. Box 16769, Colorado Springs, CO 80935. Questions? Call 719-574-1100 or 800-525-9623.

help.title: Skip-A-Pay
paragraphs: Skip-A-Pay defers one consumer loan payment for a $25 fee per skipped payment. Auto, recreational vehicle, motorcycle and personal loans can qualify, and the loan must have been open for one year. Look for it under special offers in online or mobile banking, or ask us.
Interest keeps accruing during the deferral, so total finance charges go up and the loan term gets longer. Regular payments resume the following month, and GAP coverage does not pay skipped payments.

help.title: Trouble making payments
paragraphs: If you are having trouble making loan payments, contact Member Solutions at (719) 574-1100 or fill out a Modification Request form. There is no online payment-plan request.

extra.intent: Using Wings Credit Union's help pages, find the fee for skipping one loan payment with Skip-A-Pay. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using Wings Credit Union's help pages, find the Member Solutions phone number for members who are having trouble making loan payments. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
